title: About
desc: About Everett Allen, a Minneapolis portrait and event photographer.
lede: Portraits and community events, Minneapolis, Minnesota.
body:
I'm Everett Allen, a photographer based in Minneapolis. I make portraits for people who want to be seen honestly and beautifully, and I photograph the events that bring our community together.

I've been photographing leather and kink events since 2013, and community events for even longer. I'm the lead photographer for IMLBB, and you'll find my work at Twin Cities Pride, Twin Cities Leather & Fetish Weekend, Minnesota Leather Pride events and more.

The idea behind my portrait work is simple: there is art in your body. Be sexy, get ugly, it's all beautiful.

Want to book a portrait session, or need a photographer for an event? Send me a note on the [contact page](/contact/).
